title: Scalar passage commutes with the canonical rational Hom transpose
statement: For every finite coefficient embedding E to F and every constructible pairing K tensor L to any constructible W with permitted Hom pair (L,W), the F-transpose of the scalar-extended pairing is scalar extension of the E-transpose followed by rationalHomScalarComparison. The specified tensor scalar comparison also commutes with the signed swap. No dualizing-target hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Proof paragraphs 1–3; explicit interface extracted from lem-coef-rational-retract-evaluation

proof.text: The ordinary scalar Hom comparison is the transpose of extended evaluation. Its completed comparison is conjugated by the fixed completion maps. Thus evaluation compatibility and tensor naturality give the transpose identity on integral representatives. The integral and rational normalization clauses of the completed transpose identify the same maps after localization. Separate scalar linearity extends equality from pure tensors to all arrows.

On homogeneous degrees r,s the two scalar/swap paths both send (x tensor a) tensor (y tensor b) to (-1)^(r*s) (y tensor x) tensor (a*b). Quotient, Roos and localization comparisons preserve this equation, giving the displayed symmetry square for an arbitrary coefficient embedding.
